import { Aside } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

<Aside type="danger" title="Deprecated">
  The C++ / Unreal SDK is deprecated and is no longer maintained. For new
  projects, use the [TypeScript SDK](/build/sdks/ts-sdk),
  [Python SDK](/build/sdks/python-sdk), [Go SDK](/build/sdks/go-sdk), or
  [Rust SDK](/build/sdks/rust-sdk).
</Aside>

There is a C++ / Unreal SDK for Aptos, built by Var Meta [here](https://github.com/VAR-META-Tech/Aptos-Cpp-SDK/)

## Installing the SDK

There are installation instructions, as well as usage instructions [here](https://github.com/VAR-META-Tech/Aptos-Cpp-SDK/?tab=readme-ov-file#installation-guide)
